goal: Allow importing descriptors without private keys when the wallet already holds the matching keys
Prevents users from having to expose sensitive private key material over RPC
agreement: Concept support for avoiding manual private key handling during imports (rkrux, Sjors, polespinasa)
Unaddressed objection: missing include causes an IWYU build failure, no author reply (fametrano)
Objection: re-importing creates duplicate descriptors, which author declined as out of scope (fametrano)
Suggested an alternative parsing approach using extended keys (Sjors)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it resolves a long-standing user request regarding descriptor imports
Users gain better security practices by avoiding unnecessary transmission of private keys
